label: Bible Study
prompt: So thou, O son of man, I have set thee a _____ unto the house of Israel; therefore thou shalt hear the word at my mouth, and warn them from me.
verse: So thou, O son of man, I have set thee a watchman unto the house of Israel; therefore thou shalt hear the word at my mouth, and warn them from me.
note: Ezekiel's job title — a watchman on the wall, warning the city of what's coming.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And I will give peace in the land, and ye shall lie down, and none shall make you _____: and I will rid evil beasts out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.
verse: And I will give peace in the land, and ye shall lie down, and none shall make you afraid: and I will rid evil beasts out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.
note: Peace in the land, and you lie down with none to make you afraid — the blessing every tired parent wants.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the name of the LORD, she came to prove him with hard _____.
verse: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the name of the LORD, she came to prove him with hard questions.
note: The queen of Sheba came to test Solomon with hard questions — and by the end 'there was no more spirit in her.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: They that go down to the sea in _____, that do business in great waters;
verse: They that go down to the sea in ships, that do business in great waters;
note: The sailors' stanza of Psalm 107: storm, terror, cry, calm — and a safe harbor.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: But when the _____ of the time was come, God sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,
verse: But when the fulness of the time was come, God sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,
note: 'The fulness of the time' — God's clock struck, and his Son arrived. The KJV spells fulness with one l.
